doc: _smoothstep(0.25, 0.65, x) (the open-crack window of raw_channels) over a grid that sits below the window (clipped to 0), inside it (the cubic k^2 (3 - 2k)) and above it (clipped to 1), plus x exactly at both edges and +-1e300. A float64 closed form of a few operations: 1e-9 relative, 1e-12 absolute.
